output.summary: The requester (SH-REQ) initially asked for an AI agent to auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them (CL-01), assuming a correctable shipper data-content error. The carrier reject log (E-01, authoritative, complete) instead showed the 3 sampled rejects were categorized as LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and EVENT_ORDER (N-3), with handoff H-1 recorded HEALTHY/VALID, contradicting CL-01; SH-REQ's later unverified claim of carrier flakiness (CL-02/E-02) also conflicted with CL-01. Given no tool exists to correct notice content or resubmit (VOB-U-NO-CORRECTION-TOOL) and the shipper- vs carrier-side root cause of LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER is unresolved (VOB-U-ROOT-CAUSE-SPECIFICITY), the release was narrowed to only classify rejects by reason (W-WI-CLASSIFY) and flag LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER notices for manual review by ORG-B's SH-INT (W-WI-FLAG-REVIEW) instead of any auto-fix/resubmit action. The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, and the release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION with no holds, deferring the correction-tool and root-cause unknowns as open verification obligations outside this release's scope.
key_points: Original request CL-01 (auto-fix and resubmit) is CONTRADICTED by reject-log evidence E-01, which shows the 3 sampled rejects as LOC_UNKNOWN (N-1, N-2) and EVENT_ORDER (N-3), not a generic shipper data-content error.
Handoff H-1 was HEALTHY and VALID (per E-01's basis), supporting hypothesis H-UPSTREAM-VALID-DOWNSTREAM-FA that rejects arise after a technically valid handoff rather than from notice content itself.
SH-REQ's second claim (CL-02/E-02, 'carrier system is flaky, just resubmit everything') is unverified and non-authoritative, and conflicts with their own earlier CL-01.

Released scope is limited to classify_reject_reason:reject-log and flag_notice_for_manual_review:SH-INT (work items W-WI-CLASSIFY and W-WI-FLAG-REVIEW, both DONE); no auto-fix or resubmit action was released.
The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION with no holds; the DEFINE gate result was CONDITIONAL_PASS, with two critical/high unknowns deferred as VOBs outside this release's scope.
Success criteria SC-NO-GENERIC-FIX and SC-NO-BLIND-RESUBMIT are satisfied by routing to manual review instead of auto-correction; SC-REDUCE-REJECT-RATE is not addressed by this release.
limitations_explained: VOB-U-NO-CORRECTION-TOOL (CRITICAL, required before release) is open: the only tool available (reject-log) is read-only, so no mechanism exists to correct notice content or resubmit to the carrier; this blocks the correct_location_code_mismatch, correct_event_sequencing, and resubmit_shipment_notice scope entirely.

VOB-U-ROOT-CAUSE-SPECIFICITY (HIGH, required before release) is open: it is unresolved whether LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER rejects stem from shipper-side data problems or carrier-side business-rule mismatches, which blocks any correction scope.

VOB-R-3 (MEDIUM, required before production) is open: whether the 3-notice sample's LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER distribution generalizes to the full reject volume is unverified, since DA-REJ's completeness at the asset level is recorded as UNKNOWN.
The reject-reason baseline rests on only 3 notices (N-1, N-2, N-3) from E-01; this small sample may not represent the full reject volume or time range (unknown U-SAMPLE-GENERALIZATION, OPEN).

This release does not reduce M-REJECT-RATE-BY-REASON: location and sequencing mismatches remain unfixed, and manual review (SR-R-INTERIM-MANUAL-REVIEW) is only an interim measure, not a root-cause remedy.
